entries.title: The observer reversal
entries.summary: Change the question from 'How do I win the game?' to 'How does the observer model the game, its rules and its costs?'
entries.question: Can shifting the observer's frame change the strategy without changing other people's agency?
entries.boundary: A model of interpretation, not evidence that an external game has been imposed.

entries.title: Inventio Absurdio Reductio
entries.summary: An original name for a paradox-driven method of testing assumptions through intentionally unusual scenarios.
entries.question: Which assumptions survive when an apparently absurd case is made internally consistent?
entries.boundary: Not a spell and not a proven mathematical or physical theorem; formal definition remains open.

entries.title: Entropy, available work and heat death
entries.summary: The second law constrains available work. Heat death is a possible distant consequence of certain cosmological models, not a directly observed event.
entries.question: What physical gradients or non-equilibrium structures can persist under different cosmological assumptions?
entries.boundary: No demonstrated procedure for reversing cosmic entropy or preventing the ultimate fate of the universe.

entries.title: Gravitational collapse and entropy
entries.summary: Gravitational collapse and entropy growth are not simple opposites. Black holes, for example, are associated with large entropy.
entries.question: Under what conditions might a change in spacetime geometry modify available energy gradients or information horizons?
entries.boundary: Speculation about singularities does not establish navigable passages or cosmic survival mechanisms.

entries.title: A hypothetical bifurcation point
entries.summary: A proposed question: might the transition between cosmological regimes have a critical condition rather than a single universal moment?
entries.question: Which equations, variables, and observables would define a reproducible transition?
entries.boundary: No numerical simulation, parameter set, or empirical result has yet been provided.

entries.title: ATLAS as a research notebook
entries.summary: Use Atlas to preserve assumptions, provenance, counterexamples, versions and testable predictions instead of treating intuition as final evidence.
entries.question: Can the system log alternative hypotheses and the reasons for accepting or rejecting each?
entries.boundary: This archive does not claim Atlas currently implements all these capabilities.

entries.title: The fictional journey
entries.summary: A fictional sports car, an impossible drive, and an undefined destination are used to explore control, consent, agency and observer position.
entries.question: What changes when the passenger builds the system but deliberately leaves the driver's choices free?
entries.boundary: This story is a metaphor, not a claim about Emma Watson's feelings, choices or participation.

entries.title: Stories as pattern detectors
entries.summary: Harry Potter, The Hunger Games, Mortal Kombat and Megumin serve as creative comparison points for loops, confrontation, choice, mortality and reinvention.
entries.question: Which parallels remain meaningful after differences between the fictional worlds are taken seriously?
entries.boundary: Associative parallels are interpretations; they are not physical evidence.
